campaign: Request a Consultation — v2 GREEN BASELINE (concern-led, 2026-08-13)
compliance_notes: v2 fresh baseline. GREEN PLACEHOLDER creative — solid brand green + on-image headline only. Photography + fonts finetuned later (Figma, under v1).
One concept per ad (concern-led). Coordination retired from all surfaces; lives as the plain-language payoff in body copy.
No urgency/scarcity, guarantees, performance claims, or dollar minimums. HNW signaled by situation. CFP® in body only; no CFA.
CTA = Request a Consultation on all except Ad 6 (Learn More = the single soft-CTA A/B test).
Ads 1-8 = HNW core (concern/situation-led). Ads 9-11 = MASS-AFFLUENT block, added so the client can react to the broader lane vs. the HNW weighting. Judge these on qualified-booking rate, not CTR.
